#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

const double EPS = 1e-9;

class Vec {
public:
    double x, y;
    
    Vec(double x = 0, double y = 0) : x(x), y(y) {}
    
    Vec add(const Vec& o) const { return Vec(x + o.x, y + o.y); }
    Vec sub(const Vec& o) const { return Vec(x - o.x, y - o.y); }
    Vec scale(double s) const { return Vec(x * s, y * s); }
    double dot(const Vec& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y; }
    double cross(const Vec& o) const { return x * o.y - y * o.x; }
    double mag2() const { return dot(*this); }
    double mag() const { return sqrt(mag2()); }
    Vec unit() const { return scale(1 / mag()); }
    Vec rot90() const { return Vec(-y, x); }
    Vec rot270() const { return Vec(y, -x); }
    
    Vec rotate(double theta) const {
        double newX = x * cos(theta) + y * cos(M_PI / 2 + theta);
        double newY = x * sin(theta) + y * sin(M_PI / 2 + theta);
        return Vec(newX, newY);
    }
    
    double angle() const {
        return fmod(atan2(y, x) + 2 * M_PI, 2 * M_PI);
    }
    
    static bool eq(double a, double b) { return fabs(a - b) < EPS; }
    static bool leq(double a, double b) { return a - EPS < b; }
    static bool geq(double a, double b) { return a + EPS > b; }
    
    bool operator==(const Vec& other) const {
        return eq(x, other.x) && eq(y, other.y);
    }
    
    bool operator<(const Vec& other) const {
        if (!eq(x, other.x)) return x < other.x;
        return y < other.y;
    }
};

class Circle {
public:
    Vec center;
    double radius;
    
    Circle(const Vec& center, double radius) : center(center), radius(radius) {}
    
    bool contains(const Vec& v) const {
        return center.sub(v).mag2() - EPS * EPS <= radius * radius;
    }
    
    vector<Vec> intersect(const Circle& other) const {
        if (center == other.center) return {};
        Vec dir = other.center.sub(center);
        double distSq = dir.mag2();
        double dist = sqrt(distSq);
        
        if (radius + other.radius < dist - EPS || radius + dist < other.radius - EPS || other.radius + dist < radius - EPS) {
            return {};
        }
        
        if (Vec::eq(radius + other.radius, dist) || Vec::eq(other.radius + dist, radius)) {
            return {center.add(dir.scale(radius / dist))};
        }
        if (Vec::eq(radius + dist, other.radius)) {
            return {center.sub(dir.scale(radius / dist))};
        }
        
        double d1 = (radius * radius + distSq - other.radius * other.radius) / (2 * dist);
        double h = sqrt(max(0.0, radius * radius - d1 * d1));
        Vec unitDir = dir.unit();
        Vec rightInt = center.add(unitDir.scale(d1).add(unitDir.rot270().scale(h)));
        Vec leftInt = center.add(unitDir.scale(d1).add(unitDir.rot90().scale(h)));
        return {rightInt, leftInt};
    }
};

class UnionFind {
private:
    vector<int> parent;
    int componentCount;
    
public:
    UnionFind(int n) : parent(n), componentCount(n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i;
    }
    
    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        return parent[x];
    }
    
    void unionSets(int x, int y) {
        int rootX = find(x);
        int rootY = find(y);
        if (rootX != rootY) {
            parent[rootX] = rootY;
            componentCount--;
        }
    }
    
    int getComponentCount() const {
        return componentCount;
    }
};

class FS {
private:
    istream& reader;
    
public:
    FS(istream& stream) : reader(stream) {}
    
    string next() {
        string token;
        reader >> token;
        return token;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

int main() {
    FS in(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    vector<Circle> circles;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x = in.nextInt();
        int y = in.nextInt();
        int r = in.nextInt();
        circles.emplace_back(Vec(x, y), r);
    }
    
    set<Vec> globalPoints;
    UnionFind uf(n);
    int result = 1;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        set<Vec> uniqueIntersections;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            vector<Vec> pairs = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
            if (pairs.empty()) continue;
            
            uf.unionSets(i, j);
            
            for (const Vec& p : pairs) {
                uniqueIntersections.insert(p);
            }
        }
        
        result += uniqueIntersections.size();
        
        for (const Vec& p : uniqueIntersections) {
            globalPoints.insert(p);
        }
    }
    
    result -= globalPoints.size();
    result += uf.getComponentCount();
    
    cout << result << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
